ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent cases of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts of the Minnesota DHS to prevent future instances of fraud.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How is the Minnesota DHS working to prevent future instances of fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the growing problem of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts of the Minnesota DHS to address the issue.
